en.title: T93.Lab Portfolio Analytics Workspace
en.summary: Private Taiwan/US portfolio workspace for net worth, positions, DCA, risk, journals, and cloud-synced market data.
en.challenge: Personal investment data was fragmented across devices, spreadsheets, market-data sources, and separate Taiwan/US workflows. The product needed a single private workspace without exposing credentials or portfolio data in the browser.
contribution: Designed the product model for net worth, positions, lots, DCA, realized and unrealized P&L, transfers, and trading journals.
Built Google OAuth access control, cross-device cloud synchronization, admin approval, and local-to-cloud migration.
Implemented edge APIs for quotes, symbol search, position selling, and incrementally cached portfolio history.
technical: Native HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend deployed on Cloudflare Pages with Pages Functions as the backend-for-frontend.
Supabase Auth, Postgres, PostgREST, row-level access patterns, and transactional RPC for position sales.
Market-data adapters for Nasdaq, Alpha Vantage, Finnhub, TWSE, TPEx, and USD/TWD exchange rates, with fallback logic and route tests.

architecture.label: Experience
architecture.detail: Responsive workspace, net-worth view, position manager, risk calculators, and journal.

architecture.label: Identity & sync
architecture.detail: Supabase Google OAuth, allowlist approval, cloud-sync layer, and localStorage migration.

architecture.label: Edge services
architecture.detail: Cloudflare Pages Functions validate sessions and orchestrate market, sell, and history APIs.

architecture.label: Data & jobs
architecture.detail: Supabase Postgres/RPC plus scheduled incremental history updates and provider fallbacks.

outcomes: Unified Taiwan and US holdings, liabilities, cash flow, P&L, and asset curves in one cross-device workspace.
Supports both transaction lots and average-cost DCA while preserving a common sell and reporting workflow.
Keeps market-provider secrets and T93 collection-value integration on the server side.

zh.title: T93.Lab 投資組合分析工作區
zh.summary: 私人台美投資組合工作區，整合淨資產、持倉、定期定額、風險、投資日誌與雲端同步市場資料。
zh.role: 產品負責人與全端工程師
zh.challenge: 個人投資資料散落在不同裝置、試算表、市場資料來源及分開的台股與美股流程中。產品需要提供單一私有工作區，同時避免在瀏覽器暴露憑證或投資組合資料。
contribution: 設計淨資產、持倉、交易批次、定期定額、已實現與未實現損益、轉帳及交易日誌的產品模型。
建置 Google OAuth 存取控制、跨裝置雲端同步、管理員核准及本地資料遷移至雲端的流程。
實作報價、商品搜尋、持倉賣出與增量快取投資組合歷史的邊緣 API。
technical: 原生 HTML／CSS／JavaScript 前端部署於 Cloudflare Pages，並以 Pages Functions 作為前後端中介層。
使用 Supabase Auth、Postgres、PostgREST、資料列層級存取模式，以及處理持倉賣出的交易式 RPC。
整合 Nasdaq、Alpha Vantage、Finnhub、證交所、櫃買中心與美元兌新台幣匯率的市場資料介面，並提供備援邏輯與路由測試。

architecture.label: 使用體驗
architecture.detail: 響應式工作區包含淨資產檢視、持倉管理、風險計算器與投資日誌。

architecture.label: 身分與同步
architecture.detail: Supabase Google OAuth、允許名單核准、雲端同步層與 localStorage 遷移。

architecture.label: 邊緣服務
architecture.detail: Cloudflare Pages Functions 驗證工作階段，並編排市場、賣出及歷史資料 API。

architecture.label: 資料與排程
architecture.detail: Supabase Postgres／RPC 搭配排程式增量歷史更新與資料供應商備援。

outcomes: 在單一跨裝置工作區中整合台股與美股持倉、負債、現金流、損益及資產曲線。
同時支援逐筆交易批次與平均成本定期定額，並共用一致的賣出與報告流程。
將市場資料供應商密鑰與 T93 收藏價值整合保留在伺服器端。

en.title: T93.Lab Collection & Market Platform
en.summary: Notion-powered collectible vault with valuation analytics, private access, scheduled publishing, market lookup, and commerce prototypes.
en.challenge: A private trading-card collection needed to work as a searchable collection, valuation dashboard, wishlist, and member-only market experience while keeping editorial data easy to maintain.
contribution: Built the static-site generation pipeline from Notion data, including cached exchange rates and scheduled publishing.
Designed collection filters, valuation analytics, wishlists, market lookup, shopping, auction, cart, and grading-service prototypes.
Added Supabase Google identity, independent authorization, admin review, and protected aggregate market APIs.
technical: Python/Jinja2 build process converts Notion content into deployable static pages and reusable partials.
Cloudflare Pages and Functions protect private routes and expose server-side APIs without leaking service credentials.
Supabase Auth/Postgres provides identity and access boundaries; GitHub Actions rebuilds hourly and refreshes market data on a schedule.

architecture.label: Content source
architecture.detail: Notion databases hold collection metadata, research notes, prices, and wishlists.

architecture.label: Build pipeline
architecture.detail: Python fetches and normalizes records, caches exchange rates, and renders Jinja2 pages.

architecture.label: Delivery
architecture.detail: GitHub Actions publishes the generated site to Cloudflare Pages on schedule or demand.

architecture.label: Private services
architecture.detail: Cloudflare middleware/Functions and Supabase Auth/Postgres protect users, admin data, and aggregate APIs.

outcomes: Created one product surface for collection browsing, value analysis, wishlists, and authenticated market demos.
Separated editorial collection data from transaction-oriented architecture so commerce features can evolve safely.
Connected aggregate T93 market value to the stock workspace through a server-only API.

zh.title: T93.Lab 收藏與市場平台
zh.summary: 以 Notion 驅動的收藏品管理庫，整合估值分析、私人存取、排程發布、市場查詢與商務原型。
zh.role: 產品負責人與全端工程師
zh.challenge: 私人卡牌收藏需要同時成為可搜尋的收藏庫、估值儀表板、願望清單與會員限定市場體驗，並讓編輯資料維持容易管理。
contribution: 以 Notion 資料建置靜態網站產生管線，包含匯率快取與排程發布。
設計收藏篩選、估值分析、願望清單、市場查詢、購物、拍賣、購物車與鑑定服務原型。
加入 Supabase Google 身分驗證、獨立授權、管理員審核與受保護的市場彙總 API。
technical: Python 與 Jinja2 建置流程將 Notion 內容轉換為可部署的靜態頁面及可重用局部模板。
Cloudflare Pages 與 Functions 保護私人路由，並提供伺服器端 API，避免洩漏服務憑證。
Supabase Auth 與 Postgres 提供身分及存取邊界；GitHub Actions 每小時重建並排程更新市場資料。

architecture.label: 內容來源
architecture.detail: Notion 資料庫保存收藏詮釋資料、研究筆記、價格與願望清單。

architecture.label: 建置管線
architecture.detail: Python 擷取並標準化紀錄、快取匯率，再渲染 Jinja2 頁面。

architecture.label: 交付
architecture.detail: GitHub Actions 依排程或需求將產生的網站發布至 Cloudflare Pages。

architecture.label: 私人服務
architecture.detail: Cloudflare 中介軟體與 Functions 搭配 Supabase Auth／Postgres，保護使用者、管理資料及彙總 API。

outcomes: 建立單一產品介面，整合收藏瀏覽、價值分析、願望清單與身分驗證市場展示。
將編輯型收藏資料與交易導向架構分離，使商務功能能安全演進。
透過僅限伺服器存取的 API，將 T93 市場彙總價值連接至投資工作區。

en.title: quan — Taiwan Quant Research Toolkit
en.summary: Python research-to-paper-trading framework with Taiwan market data, cost-aware backtests, walk-forward validation, and Shioaji adapters.
en.challenge: Taiwan-market research needs consistent data, realistic costs, repeatable backtests, strong validation, and a safe path from strategy output to paper execution before any live deployment.
contribution: Designed a layered Python package and CLI for data preparation, strategy research, reporting, and broker-neutral execution.
Implemented Taiwan futures cost models, continuous-contract helpers, strategy comparison, parameter sweeps, and walk-forward validation.
Integrated paper execution and Shioaji adapters with market-hours, expiry, order-size, kill-switch, rate-limit, and reconciliation guards.
technical: Canonical OHLCV pipeline with Yahoo Finance, FinMind, TAIFEX, local CSV, and Shioaji real-time adapters.
Backtrader event-driven research with eleven strategy templates, external strategy loading, metrics, CSV/JSON reports, and SVG charts.
Target-position runtime separates strategy decisions from broker orders so the same logic can move from dry-run to simulation safely.

architecture.label: Market data
architecture.detail: Downloaders and adapters normalize OHLCV, futures contracts, calendars, and live ticks.

architecture.label: Research
architecture.detail: Strategies run through Backtrader with Taiwan-market costs, benchmarks, optimization, and walk-forward validation.

architecture.label: Decision
architecture.detail: Validated strategy output is converted into target positions rather than direct orders.

architecture.label: Execution
architecture.detail: Runtime guards, paper/Shioaji adapters, callbacks, reconciliation, and reports control downstream execution.

outcomes: Delivered a repeatable research-to-paper-trading foundation with automated tests and explicit safety boundaries.
Made strategies extensible without modifying the core package through scaffolding, config files, and external loading.
Documents limitations clearly: the framework is research infrastructure, not a claim of profitable or unattended live trading.

zh.title: quan — 台灣量化研究工具組
zh.summary: 從研究到模擬交易的 Python 框架，整合台灣市場資料、交易成本回測、滾動前推驗證與 Shioaji 介面。
zh.role: 量化研究與平台工程師
zh.challenge: 台灣市場研究需要一致資料、合理交易成本、可重複回測、嚴謹驗證，以及在正式上線前從策略輸出安全銜接至模擬交易的路徑。
contribution: 設計分層 Python 套件與命令列介面，涵蓋資料準備、策略研究、報告與券商中立的執行層。
實作台灣期貨成本模型、連續合約工具、策略比較、參數掃描與滾動前推驗證。
整合模擬執行與 Shioaji 介面，加入交易時段、到期日、下單量、緊急停止、速率限制與對帳防護。
technical: 標準 OHLCV 管線整合 Yahoo Finance、FinMind、TAIFEX、本地 CSV 與 Shioaji 即時資料介面。
以 Backtrader 進行事件驅動研究，提供十一種策略範本、外部策略載入、指標、CSV／JSON 報告與 SVG 圖表。
目標部位執行環境將策略決策與券商訂單分離，使同一邏輯能安全地從試跑移至模擬交易。

architecture.label: 市場資料
architecture.detail: 下載器與介面標準化 OHLCV、期貨合約、交易日曆與即時報價。

architecture.label: 研究
architecture.detail: 策略透過 Backtrader 執行，納入台灣市場成本、基準、最佳化與滾動前推驗證。

architecture.label: 決策
architecture.detail: 通過驗證的策略輸出會轉換為目標部位，而非直接產生訂單。

architecture.label: 執行
architecture.detail: 執行防護、模擬與 Shioaji 介面、回呼、對帳及報告共同控制後續交易。

outcomes: 交付可重複的研究至模擬交易基礎，包含自動化測試與明確安全邊界。
透過腳手架、設定檔與外部載入機制，使策略可擴充而不必修改核心套件。
清楚說明限制：此框架是研究基礎設施，不代表獲利保證或可無人監督進行實盤交易。

en.title: UDI Shipping Assistance System
en.summary: Operational scanning workflow that imports shipment plans, validates GS1 UDI, flags exceptions, and exports auditable completion records.
en.challenge: Daily shipping teams needed a safer way to import shipment plans, scan medical-product UDI codes, catch over-scans or mismatches, and produce an auditable end-of-day result.
contribution: Modeled the shipment workflow from plan import through order selection, scan validation, review, submission, and final export.
Built GS1 Element String, HRI, and Digital Link parsing with internal-product mapping and explicit exception states.
Added SQLite persistence, Excel export, database backup, runtime configuration, feature tiers, license handling, Docker packaging, and integration tests.
technical: FastAPI exposes a versioned operational API and serves a focused single-page scanning interface.
Browser session state keeps in-progress scans temporary; only confirmed orders are committed to SQLite.
Service modules separate plan import, UDI mapping, validation, submission, reporting, and launcher behavior.

architecture.label: Input
architecture.detail: CSV/XLSX shipment plan and scanned GS1 UDI strings enter the operator workspace.

architecture.label: Validation
architecture.detail: UDI parser and mapping data resolve GTIN/UDI-DI, part number, item, and expected quantity.

architecture.label: Workflow API
architecture.detail: FastAPI services manage previews, exception states, submissions, statistics, and session reset.

architecture.label: Records
architecture.detail: Confirmed results persist to SQLite; Excel summaries and a database backup are exported at close.

outcomes: Turns scan exceptions into explicit operator decisions instead of silent shipping errors.
Provides auditable order history, daily statistics, Excel settlement, and backup artifacts.
Includes route-level unit and real HTTP integration coverage for the operational API.

zh.title: UDI 出貨輔助系統
zh.summary: 匯入出貨計畫、驗證 GS1 UDI、標示例外，並輸出可稽核完成紀錄的作業系統。
zh.role: 解決方案架構師與全端工程師
zh.challenge: 每日出貨團隊需要更安全的方式匯入出貨計畫、掃描醫療產品 UDI、攔截超量掃描或不符項目，並產生可稽核的日終結果。
contribution: 建立從計畫匯入、訂單選擇、掃描驗證、覆核、送出到最終匯出的完整出貨流程模型。
建置 GS1 Element String、HRI 與 Digital Link 解析，整合內部產品對應及明確例外狀態。
加入 SQLite 持久化、Excel 匯出、資料庫備份、執行設定、功能分級、授權處理、Docker 封裝與整合測試。
technical: FastAPI 提供版本化作業 API，並服務專注於掃描工作的單頁介面。
瀏覽器工作階段狀態暫存進行中的掃描，只有確認後的訂單才寫入 SQLite。
服務模組分離計畫匯入、UDI 對應、驗證、送出、報告與啟動器行為。

architecture.label: 輸入
architecture.detail: CSV／XLSX 出貨計畫與掃描的 GS1 UDI 字串進入操作員工作區。

architecture.label: 驗證
architecture.detail: UDI 解析器與對應資料解析 GTIN／UDI-DI、料號、品項與預期數量。

architecture.label: 工作流程 API
architecture.detail: FastAPI 服務管理預覽、例外狀態、送出、統計與工作階段重設。

architecture.label: 紀錄
architecture.detail: 確認結果保存至 SQLite；結束作業時匯出 Excel 摘要與資料庫備份。

outcomes: 將掃描例外轉換為明確的操作員決策，避免成為未被發現的出貨錯誤。
提供可稽核訂單歷程、每日統計、Excel 結算與備份檔案。
作業 API 具備路由層單元測試與真實 HTTP 整合測試。

en.title: Multi-box UDI Data Matrix Decoder
en.summary: Benchmark-driven computer-vision POC for decoding dense carton images into GS1 business fields with safe PASS/REVIEW handling.
en.challenge: Dense shipping photos can contain many small Data Matrix codes with perspective, occlusion, and repeated cartons. Missing a code must lead to review rather than an unsafe automatic pass.
contribution: Developed a multi-box detection and local-ROI search pipeline tuned for lower-band Data Matrix placement on cartons.
Combined multiple decoder engines, GS1 parsing, product mapping, density-aware rescue budgets, and annotated artifact export.
Created benchmark histories and PASS/REVIEW gates based on expected counts and decoded completeness.
technical: Candidate boxes are ranked toward complete carton hypotheses, then local regions are searched with scale and scene-density aware budgets.
Decoded content is normalized from GS1 element strings or Digital Links into business fields and mapped to internal products.
Every run can emit JSON, CSV, candidate data, attempt summaries, benchmark snapshots, and annotated review images.

architecture.label: Image
architecture.detail: Whole shipping image enters product-box proposal and ranking.

architecture.label: ROI search
architecture.detail: Per-box lower-band and rescue strategies generate Data Matrix candidates.

architecture.label: Decode & parse
architecture.detail: ZXing/pylibdmtx decode symbols; GS1 parsing extracts DI, dates, lot, and serial fields.

architecture.label: Business output
architecture.detail: Mapping enrichment, expected-count gate, JSON/CSV artifacts, and annotated review support PASS or REVIEW.

outcomes: Passed the documented fixed five-image suite at 5/5, 5/5, 7/7, 8/8, and 12/12 decoded symbols.
Established a stronger dense-scene baseline with 47 decoded symbols on the recorded reference image.
Communicates POC limitations and routes incomplete recognition to review rather than claiming universal recall.

zh.title: 多箱 UDI Data Matrix 解碼器
zh.summary: 以基準測試驅動的電腦視覺概念驗證，將高密度紙箱影像解碼為 GS1 業務欄位，並以 PASS／REVIEW 安全分流。
zh.role: 電腦視覺與資料工程師
zh.challenge: 高密度出貨照片可能包含大量尺寸很小、具有透視變形、遮擋及重複紙箱的 Data Matrix。若漏讀任何代碼，系統必須轉交人工覆核，而不能不安全地自動通過。
contribution: 開發多紙箱偵測與局部感興趣區域搜尋管線，針對紙箱下方區域的 Data Matrix 位置進行調校。
整合多種解碼引擎、GS1 解析、產品對應、依密度調整的補救預算與標註檔案匯出。
建立基準測試歷程，並依預期數量與解碼完整度設定 PASS／REVIEW 閘門。
technical: 候選紙箱依完整紙箱假設排序，再以縮放比例與場景密度感知的預算搜尋局部區域。
將 GS1 元素字串或 Digital Link 解碼內容標準化為業務欄位，並對應內部產品。
每次執行可輸出 JSON、CSV、候選資料、嘗試摘要、基準快照與供覆核使用的標註影像。

architecture.label: 影像
architecture.detail: 完整出貨影像進入產品紙箱候選產生與排序流程。

architecture.label: 區域搜尋
architecture.detail: 針對每個紙箱的下方區域與補救策略產生 Data Matrix 候選。

architecture.label: 解碼與解析
architecture.detail: ZXing 與 pylibdmtx 解碼符號；GS1 解析器擷取 DI、日期、批號與序號。

architecture.label: 業務輸出
architecture.detail: 產品對應補充、預期數量閘門、JSON／CSV 檔案與標註覆核共同支援 PASS 或 REVIEW。

outcomes: 在記錄的固定五張影像測試集中，分別達成 5／5、5／5、7／7、8／8 與 12／12 個符號解碼。
在記錄的參考影像上解碼 47 個符號，建立更強的高密度場景基準。
清楚傳達概念驗證限制，並將不完整辨識轉交覆核，而非宣稱能涵蓋所有情況。

en.title: 888 Card Market Platform
en.summary: Full-stack vendor reservation and administration system with booth availability, rental inventory, and generated contracts.
en.challenge: A physical card market needed one system for brand presentation, vendor onboarding, booth availability, reservations, rental extras, contract generation, and staff administration.
contribution: Designed the vendor journey from registration and login through date/booth selection, equipment rental, reservation, and contract creation.
Built role-protected admin operations for users, bookings, contracts, open dates, rental inventory, and CSV exchange.
Containerized the Vue client, Node API, and MySQL database with an optional Cloudflare tunnel for demonstrations.
technical: Vue 3/Vite single-page frontend with Pinia and route-based Home, Reserve, and Admin experiences.
Express/Sequelize API handles JWT auth, availability, reservations, staff roles, uploads, and management endpoints.
PDFKit generates Chinese reservation contracts; Docker volumes preserve contracts and MySQL data.

architecture.label: Client
architecture.detail: Vue SPA presents the brand site, vendor reservation flow, and role-aware administration.

architecture.label: API
architecture.detail: Express validates identity and coordinates booth, date, rental, reservation, and admin services.

architecture.label: Domain data
architecture.detail: Sequelize persists members, availability, reservations, and configuration in MySQL.

architecture.label: Documents & delivery
architecture.detail: PDFKit creates contracts in persistent storage; Docker Compose runs client, API, database, and optional tunnel.

outcomes: Delivered an end-to-end demonstrator rather than a disconnected marketing page and admin mockup.
Automated reservation contracts and centralized the operational settings staff need to run open market dates.
Defined a clear extension path for payments, e-signature, audit logs, object storage, and commerce modules.

zh.title: 888 卡牌市集平台
zh.summary: 全端攤商預約與管理系統，整合攤位可用性、租賃庫存與合約產生。
zh.role: 解決方案架構師與全端工程師
zh.challenge: 實體卡牌市集需要一套系統，統一處理品牌展示、攤商加入、攤位可用性、預約、加租設備、合約產生與員工管理。
contribution: 設計從註冊登入、日期與攤位選擇、設備租借，到預約及合約建立的完整攤商流程。
建置角色權限保護的後台作業，管理使用者、預約、合約、開放日期、租賃庫存與 CSV 交換。
將 Vue 用戶端、Node API 與 MySQL 資料庫容器化，並提供選用的 Cloudflare Tunnel 進行展示。
technical: 以 Vue 3、Vite 與 Pinia 建立單頁前端，並透過路由區分首頁、預約與管理體驗。
Express 與 Sequelize API 處理 JWT 驗證、可用性、預約、員工角色、上傳及管理端點。
PDFKit 產生中文預約合約，Docker Volume 保存合約與 MySQL 資料。

architecture.label: 用戶端
architecture.detail: Vue 單頁應用呈現品牌網站、攤商預約流程與依角色顯示的管理介面。

architecture.label: API

為金流、電子簽章、稽核紀錄、物件儲存與商務模組定義清楚的擴充路徑。

en.title: X Media Downloader
en.summary: Configurable Python utility for retrieving recent account media through X API v2 with filters, pagination, rate limits, and CDN fallbacks.
en.challenge: A repeatable collection workflow needed to retrieve only recent media from a selected X account while handling API limits, media variants, and unreliable image URLs.

Implemented pagination, keyword filters, best-video selection, rate-limit waiting, and photo-size fallbacks.
Separated API retrieval, media normalization, and file download into testable utility functions and data objects.
technical: X API v2 resolves accounts and recent posts; expansions return attached media metadata.
The downloader selects original/large/medium/small fallbacks and browser-compatible headers for CDN reliability.
dotenv configuration keeps bearer tokens out of source while CLI flags support scheduled or ad-hoc runs.

architecture.label: Configuration
architecture.detail: Environment variables and CLI options define account, time range, filters, and output policy.

architecture.label: X API
architecture.detail: Authenticated requests resolve the user, page through recent posts, and expand media metadata.

architecture.label: Selection
architecture.detail: Keyword/media filters, variant ranking, URL normalization, and duplicate control select artifacts.

architecture.label: Download
architecture.detail: Resilient HTTP retrieval writes timestamped media files and reports rate-limit or content failures.

outcomes: Reduced a manual monitoring task to a repeatable, configurable Python workflow.
Handles common operational failure modes instead of assuming one media URL or an unlimited API.
Supports photo-first use while allowing videos, replies, and reposts when explicitly enabled.

zh.title: X 媒體下載工具
zh.summary: 可設定的 Python 工具，透過 X API v2 擷取近期帳號媒體，並處理篩選、分頁、速率限制與 CDN 備援。

實作分頁、關鍵字篩選、最佳影片版本選擇、速率限制等待與圖片尺寸備援。
將 API 擷取、媒體標準化與檔案下載拆分為可測試的工具函式與資料物件。
technical: X API v2 解析帳號與近期貼文，並透過 expansions 回傳附件媒體的詮釋資料。

architecture.label: 設定

architecture.label: 選取

architecture.label: 下載

outcomes: 將人工監控工作縮減為可重複、可設定的 Python 流程。
處理常見營運失敗情境，而非假設只有單一媒體網址或無限制 API。
預設支援圖片優先使用，也可在明確啟用後處理影片、回覆與轉發。

en.title: Production Planning Copilot

en.challenge: Production planners need to query schedules, facts, constraints, and operating knowledge in natural language without letting an LLM invent production data.

architecture.label: Interface

architecture.label: Orchestration

Separates components and ports so a second stack can run without dependency or service collisions.

zh.title: 生產規劃 Copilot

建置多語問答轉換、確定性備援行為、種子資料與啟動自動化。

architecture.label: 知識

outcomes: 展示如何將 LLM 互動建立在營運系統的事實上，而非自由生成。
當外部模型憑證不可用時，仍以確定性範本維持展示功能。
分離元件與連接埠，使第二套技術堆疊也能執行而不產生相依或服務衝突。

en.title: GraphDB MCP Server
en.summary: Open-source Model Context Protocol connector that gives LLM clients controlled, read-only access to GraphDB repositories and SPARQL.

Published the connector and its usage documentation as an open-source repository.
technical: JavaScript MCP server accepts structured tool requests from compatible LLM clients.
GraphDB HTTP endpoints execute repository discovery and read-only SPARQL queries.
Responses are normalized for conversational use while the server preserves a constrained access surface.

architecture.label: LLM client

architecture.label: Grounded result

outcomes: Shows practical integration of the Model Context Protocol with enterprise semantic infrastructure.
Reduces the privilege surface by focusing the public connector on read-only graph access.
Reuses knowledge-graph experience from sustainability and R&D systems in a portable developer tool.

記錄模型啟動、持久化、環境設定與部署路徑。
發布公開儲存庫與線上展示端點，降低評估門檻。

展現超越 Notebook 實驗的容器、API 與模型執行環境整合能力。
